issue_request: FHIR-49109 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Task. It asked why Task example binding names such as TaskInputParameterType and TaskOutputParameterType implied value sets when none existed, and the accepted OO resolution was to add example binding descriptions/codes for Task performer function code, Task reason, input/output parameter code, and business status.
initial_application: Commit 768642cfce added Task example value sets/code systems and valueSet references for Task.businessStatus, Task.performer.function, Task.reason, Task.input.type, and Task.output.type. Commit 41df358d87 consolidated Task input/output parameter bindings onto ValueSet/task-inputoutput-parameter-type. That implementation substantially applied the issue but left Task.output.type with a description that still said 'input parameters'.
additional_context: FHIR-45320 is a same-change-family issue for TaskBusinessStatus and explicitly resolved to make the fix described in FHIR-49109. FHIR-I minutes left the choice in OO's hands, and OO WGM minutes list FHIR-49109 for COW discussion. FHIR-50258 later added data-retrieval codes to the shared input/output code system and is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-56060 is a later broader display-name cleanup not decided here.
reconciliation: Changed source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml so Task.output.type describes codes for output parameters while retaining the shared task-inputoutput-parameter-type example value set. No generated-looking diagram/SVG artifact was edited.
